LanguageData.OARK_AccountInquiry: Ask a certain research officer for information about the ledgers
LanguageData.OARK_GravTechPointEMBlockDays: Under righteous sanction by the Coordination Department: {0} days remaining
LanguageData.OARK_LetterLabel_EMReview: Communication Request from the Research Department
LanguageData.OARK_Letter_EMReview:
You've received a communication from the Research Department.

In the communication, the Research Department's attendants inform you of something that has them in an utter panic: thanks to their long-term disorderly and chaotic resource management and material deficits, as well as a recent celebration held after another research breakthrough which consumed a massive amount of materials, the usually tolerant Coordination Department has finally run out of patience and issued them an ultimatum—within a few days, the Coordination Department will conduct a comprehensive audit of the Research Department.

And also thanks to their usual chaotic account management, the entire Research Department can't produce a single complete ledger. For this reason, they have come to you, hoping you can assist them in organizing this chaotic raw data into a usable ledger that can pass the upcoming review.

Their tone is quite panicked, and sounds of rummaging can be heard from time to time in the communication. You realize they might be truly doomed this time.
LanguageData.OARK_EMReview_Accept: I will assist you with this problem.
LanguageData.OARK_EMReview_Reject: You should be responsible for your own actions.
LanguageData.OARK_Letter_EMReviewReject:
Things developed as expected.

Without assistance in organizing their accounts, the Research Department was utterly defeated in the Coordination Department's review. When their ledger records, full of loopholes and self-contradictions, were placed on the Coordination Department's desk, a sharp roar erupted from the entire department, said to be clearly audible from several kilometers away.

And as the main culprits for all of this, by popular demand, the Research Department was jointly sanctioned by the Coordination Department and the Court Department. It is expected that for a long time to come, the Research Department will not be able to casually hold research summits or waste materials with impunity.
LanguageData.OARK_Letter_EconomyMinistryReviewRemind: Now you can obtain the daily data compiled by the research officers through the communication station, which will help your defense and enhance the results and benefits of assistance.
LanguageData.OARK_EMReviewAcceptInfo: You decide to assist the Research Department with this problem. The Research Department will send you the raw data files, and during the review period, you can obtain new information daily through their communications.
LanguageData.OARK_EMReviewAcceptFailInfo: You decide to assist the Research Department with this problem... but the attendant on the other end of the comms seems to have gone rummaging again and didn't answer your call...
LanguageData.OARK_EconomyMinistryReview_OutcomeRoot: After all the accounts were sorted out and the Coordination Department completed their information gathering, the Research Department's judgment day finally arrived.\n\nAs one of the participants in this review, you were specially invited to observe.
LanguageData.OARK_EconomyMinistryReview_OutcomeWait:
...
...

Based on the available information, the Coordination Department has finally made a decision.
LanguageData.OARK_EconomyMinistryReview_OutcomeSD:
Thanks to your assistance, the Research Department managed to barely explain the massive material losses they caused. Although the accounts were still full of loopholes, thanks to the nature of the Research Department and the gentle coordination from the Court Department, they ultimately escaped this trial under the meaningful gaze of the Coordinator, drenched in cold sweat.

While it's foreseeable that another review is just around the corner if they don't correct their problems, at least for now, they no longer have to rummage through everything to find that ledger from their dreams.

As a reward for your assistance, you receive {0} Research Contribution from the Research Department.
LanguageData.OARK_EconomyMinistryReview_OutcomeEM:
Thanks to your assistance, the Coordination Department successfully collected a large amount of raw, chaotic data.
This data all highlighted the Research Department's extremely chaotic material management. Each piece of information, while inflicting blue soul damage on the members of the Coordination Department, also became the best "evidence" to incriminate the Research Department.

The final verdict was without suspense. Facing a joint review from the Court Department and the Coordination Department, the disastrous loopholes in the Research Department's material management were completely exposed. Under this indisputable result, with incredibly aggrieved expressions on their faces, the members of the Research Department received their due punishment—in the days to come, all material requisitions (especially for Lava-Flow Flower Cakes) will be strictly reviewed, and during this time, they must learn how to cherish materials to avoid becoming a black hole of material loss again.

As a reward for your assistance, you receive {0} Support Contribution from the Coordination Department.
LanguageData.OARK_EconomyMinistryReview_OutcomeWinWin:
Thanks to your assistance, the Coordination Department successfully collected a large amount of raw, chaotic data. But also thanks to the information you diligently collected from the research officers, you were able to successfully defend the Research Department's actions to a certain extent.

With your defense and explanation, along with the repeated agreements from the Research Department attendants nearby, although the Coordination Department possessed that unsightly chaotic data, they ultimately gave up further pursuit with skeptical expressions.

However, even though the Research Department successfully passed this review, the fatal inquiries raised by the Coordination Department about the data still left a significant impression on its members. You notice that after the review, the members of the Research Department seem to have started pondering something, while the not-so-distant Coordinator watches their backs, her helpless expression gradually turning into one of relief.

Perhaps they have truly understood each other.

As a reward for your assistance, you receive {0} Research Contribution from the Research Department, and {0} Support Points from the Coordination Department.
LanguageData.OARK_EconomyMinistryReview_OutcomeUnknow:
Thanks to you... wait, your link was inexplicably interrupted, why? You haven't even seen the ending yet.
